title: Mediterranean Herb Fish Bowl
description: A flavorful and healthy bowl filled with marinated fish, herbs, and Mediterranean flavors.

ingredients.name: fish (4 servings)
ingredients.amount: 4 (6 oz) pieces of fish (such as cod or tilapia)

ingredients.name: herb mix (such as thyme, oregano, and rosemary)

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the fish pieces on the baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, and sprinkle with herb mix, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, prepare the Mediterranean salad mix according to package instructions.
Once the fish is done, serve it on top of the salad mix.
